strategy_ideas: Implement a 'Mega-Cap Short Filter' that requires price to be below the 20-period EMA on the 15-minute chart in addition to being below VWAP before allowing short entries on AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL.
Test a 'VWAP Reclaim Confirmation' rule where long entries are only permitted if price crosses above VWAP and holds for 5 minutes, filtering out false breakouts in choppy markets.
